answer: Admission runs on layered shale escrow: a new identity's deposit is held in strata, one layer thawing per audited epoch of clean work, and the required depth doubles every time one funder's key set grows, so each extra alias pays twice the last. Randomized prisms audit every stratum - timing, output and funding bands - and one failed band collapses the whole stack into a burn. Strata accrue per key on live work, so a farm can neither pre-age nor parallelize its way up the mesa cheaply.
